headline: Nigerian Exchange Market Cap Reaches Record N164.9 Trillion
summary: The Nigerian Exchange extended its bull run as total equities market capitalization hit a historic high of N164.91 trillion and the All Share Index closed at 253,990 points.
why: Record highs on national stock exchanges reflect strong local equity inflows and broader market valuation growth.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Higher equity valuations boost investor confidence and corporate capital-raising capacity within local capital markets.

why_moved: Sustained buying pressure across listed equities pushed capitalization and index levels to unprecedented peaks.
